problem_summary: B2B outreach fails when messages are generic. Reps lack time to research each prospect. This process automates public research, selects a relevant hook, drafts outreach grounded in evidence, and keeps a human in the loop before anything is sent.
value_proposition: Replaces roughly 15–20 minutes of manual tab research with an automated pipeline the rep can review in a few minutes—while blocking wrong-person mistakes and unsupported claims.

process_stages.title: Identify
process_stages.description: Search public sources, propose a match on name/company/role, and require explicit confirmation (with sources) before research spend.

process_stages.title: Research
process_stages.description: Run bounded searches in three areas: professional background, company developments, and recruiting context. Results stream into the UI as each area completes.

process_stages.title: Draft
process_stages.description: Choose one angle, write a short cold email for the case-study recruiting product, and attach claim-level evidence review metadata.

process_stages.title: Review
process_stages.description: Edit the draft, inspect sources, deselect evidence, add a public URL, regenerate, and confirm the final message. Nothing is sent automatically.

assumptions: Prospect inputs are name, company, role, and optional LinkedIn URL—matching how an SDR would start from a list row.
Research uses public web search passages (Firecrawl) and Gemini for identity matching and drafting; no LinkedIn API or logged-in scraping.
The recruiting platform in drafts comes from the case-study product brief (the fictional product being sold—not Zamp's own product). This workspace is the Zamp ASA PS-3 submission.
A single shared demo workspace is acceptable; evaluators authenticate on public deployments with HTTP Basic (username demo).
Outbound email delivery is out of scope; the output is a reviewed draft ready to paste into a sequencer.

tools.name: Firecrawl
tools.role: Public web search and page retrieval for identity and research

tools.name: Google Gemini
tools.role: Structured identity assessment, evidence-aware drafting, and inline claim review

happy_path.name: Sasa Ferrari
happy_path.why: Well-documented TA leader; expect a grounded draft that respects existing hiring analytics context.
steps: Select demo prospect P01 (Clear starting point).
Confirm identity, wait for research in all three tabs.
Open Review: read angle, evidence strength, and sources used.
Optionally regenerate with one source deselected or after adding a public URL.

edge_cases.title: Same name, different people
edge_cases.why_it_matters: Research attached to the wrong person destroys trust instantly.
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Identity step distinguishes Don Fogarty at Attio via profile URL; user confirms before research.

edge_cases.title: Employer name mismatch
edge_cases.why_it_matters: Public sources may show legacy or related entity names (e.g. acquisition context).
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Surface conflict evidence; user confirms resolved employer rather than assuming a job change.

edge_cases.title: Thin public evidence
edge_cases.why_it_matters: Most lists include prospects without rich news or careers data.
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Restrained draft and/or limitation banner; no invented hiring surge or internal pain.

edge_cases.title: Wrong pitch angle
edge_cases.why_it_matters: Personalisation requires reading what the company values, not defaulting to speed.
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Draft respects quality-first hiring philosophy; coordination/feedback angles over 'hire faster'.

live_demo_checklist: Run one identity edge case (P04 or P03) and narrate why confirmation exists.
Run P05 or P06 and point to limitation / angle choice in Review.
Show run history in the sidebar and a confirmed draft state.
limitations_and_next: Search passages are index snippets, not full page archives—claim review reflects that boundary.
Live runs depend on third-party API availability and rate limits; use Retry on failed stages.
Next: CRM export, team templates, send-queue integration, and scheduled re-research for stale runs.
